## 更新内容

3.0.2 修复严重的任务启动与状态判定问题，并累计包含 3.0.0 之后的全部更新。3.0.1 已撤下，建议直接升级到 3.0.2。

- **修复输入失效后仍启动并卡在 0%**：F9 压制前实际加载脚本，显示缺失引用文件的具体错误；正式压制和自动压制重新校验输入，不再使用过期预览缓存。排队任务开始执行时也会重新检查输入。
- **统一任务失败与完成判定**：修复管道先关闭时漏掉源进程失败、日志读取异常后任务继续等待，以及自动压制错误事件被退出码 0 或后续完成事件覆盖的问题。任务结束后，延迟到达的进度不会使其重新变成运行中。
- **加强输出验证**：自动压制校验实际视频流；音频和蓝光解复用拒绝缺失或空产物；蓝光任务确认选中轨道的产物后才报告完成。防止无效产物替换已有文件，并拒绝复用有残留内容的任务暂存目录。
- **改进进程清理与预览**：探测、日志收尾和预览响应均有等待上限；取消或读取失败时清理进程树，预览辅助进程失去响应后释放会话。
- **deew 状态与日志修复**：实时显示完整 stdout/stderr 输出，保留末尾未换行的诊断；首页同步显示阶段和百分比。复用 deew CLI 的算法显示“当前阶段剩余约…”，运行满 5 秒后出现，切换阶段重新估算；保留响度，移除没有数据来源的速度、码率占位。
- **累计界面修复**：保留音频和自动压制页面切换后的控件；修复导航时亮度跳变、表单与操作栏空白间距，以及深色下拉弹层配色。
- **x265 发布分离**：推荐的 4.3（8/10 位 multilib）从 [x265 专用仓库](https://github.com/frankie1024/x265-windows-builds/releases/tag/4.3-multilib.1)下载，保持已验证的二进制和 SHA256，对应源码和许可证在该仓库提供。3.0.0 旧附件保留兼容。

提供 Windows x64 安装包、便携 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

## Update Notes

3.0.2 fixes critical task startup and completion handling and includes all updates since 3.0.0. Version 3.0.1 has been withdrawn; upgrade directly to 3.0.2.

- **Reject invalid inputs before starting**: F9 evaluates scripts and shows missing dependency errors. Video and automatic encoding revalidate sources instead of trusting cached previews; queued tasks check inputs again when execution begins.
- **Correct task failure and completion handling**: detect source failures after pipe EOF, interrupt processes when output readers fail, and prevent exit code 0 or later completion events from overriding automatic encoding failures. Late progress cannot reopen a finished video task.
- **Validate outputs before publishing**: automatic encoding checks for a readable video stream. Audio and Blu-ray demux reject missing or empty outputs; demux completes only after selected outputs are checked and published. Existing files remain protected from invalid replacements, and stale task staging directories are rejected.
- **Improve cleanup and preview recovery**: bounded probe, output-drain and preview-response waits; process-tree cleanup on cancellation or reader failure; unresponsive preview sessions are closed.
- **Fix deew status and logs**: forward live stdout/stderr and preserve final unterminated diagnostics. Show stage and percentage on the dashboard. Estimate remaining time for the current stage using the deew CLI algorithm after five seconds, resetting on stage changes. Preserve loudness and remove unsupported speed/bitrate placeholders.
- **Cumulative interface fixes**: retain audio/auto controls across navigation, stabilize page brightness, remove empty form/action-bar gutters and match dark dropdown popups to the application palette.
- **Separate x265 releases**: the verified 4.3 8/10-bit multilib package, matching source and licenses are available from the [dedicated x265 repository](https://github.com/frankie1024/x265-windows-builds/releases/tag/4.3-multilib.1). Existing 3.0.0 assets remain available for compatibility.

Windows x64 installer, portable ZIP and SHA256 checksums are provided.
